text:
Noah: Quick sync  following up on the SI onboarding badging flow and the joint marketplace announcement timeline. Need alignment on trainer credentials, badge artwork, and legal embargo windows. Can we lock details by Fri?

Priya: Marketing needs partner blurbs + logo consent form. Also, badge artwork must follow partner co-brand guidelines. If partners want custom colorways, that adds 48hrs.

Eleni: For badges: proposing two tiers (Certified Mentor, Certified Trainer) with unique IDs embedded in the badge metadata for verification. We'll use short QR codes linking to a verification page. Need to confirm data retention policy for verification records.

legal-bot: [policy] retention note: verification records stored for 90 days for audit, flag if requested for longer retention. Partners requiring alternate retention must be flagged to legal@redwood.

Marco: Ops question: how are physical kits tied to badges? We currently atomically issue badge after cert pass + kit return label scanned. Some partners want badges before shipping to let mentors register. Risk: badge issued before kit arrives may be abused.

Noah: Leaning to issuing digital provisional badges on pass, final badge after kit scan or 7 days post-shipment, whichever comes first. Add audit trail in the LMS.

Priya: Marketplace announcement: creative wants a 1-line partner quote and permission to use logo. Lock by Tue EOD to hit our Sep 10 announcement. Also need the feature flag name for the SI onboarding listing.

Eleni: Training flow changes: update the certification quiz to include a short live demo capture (30s screencast) as evidence of bringup. That reduces false passes. We should also add a manual spot-check of 10% of submissions.

Marco: Shipping ops: I'll add "Provisional badge applies until verification" sticker on packing slip. For exporters: include ECCN fields when country != US and add commercial invoice.

Noah: Action items:
- Priya: collect partner blurbs + consent forms (due Tue EOD).
- Eleni: update badge artwork + verification URL (due Wed).
- Marco: update packing slips + manifest templates (due Thu).
- Legal: confirm retention exception process (due Thu).

ops-bot: [automation] badge-issue-run scheduled (run_id=badge-run-3101)  estimated start: 2026-09-05T14:00:00Z.

Priya: If partners request embargoed quotes, ping legal early. I'll assemble a one-page creative brief and share in #marketing.

Eleni: I'll draft the verification endpoint and a short FAQ for partners describing how QR verification works. Will post to /docs/si/badging once approved.

Marco: Noted. Shipping offshore: partners in APAC asked for IEC adapters; flagging those now so procurement can include them.

Noah: Thanks all. If no blockers, I'll close this thread end of day Friday and post the consolidated checklist. :white_check_mark:
